description.value: Luppolo Brewing Company is a neighbourhood craft brewery and tasting room in Vancouver's East Side, inspired by the relaxed social culture of the Italian birrificio, pairing an extensive rotating tap list with hand-stretched authentic Italian pizzas made fresh daily in partnership with Local Pizzaiolo. The brewery has been a community gathering spot for nearly a decade, owned and shaped by two couples whose warmth sets the tone for the space. Touring cyclists will find dedicated bike parking, a full food menu, and a wide range of non-alcoholic and gluten-free drink options.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (3 spaces) at 63m. Total: 3 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is rich and fully fetched. The FAQ page explicitly confirms bike racks ('There are bike racks in front of the brewery and additional spots in our parking lot on the east side of the building'), on-site washrooms that are wheelchair accessible, and takeout beer sales ('Yes. We offer a selection of cans and bottles available for purchase in the tasting room'). The food menu and FAQ confirm extensive vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options. One OSM tag discrepancy noted: outdoor_seating=no in OSM, but the FAQ and website clearly confirm a seasonal patio exists.
concerns: OSM tag outdoor_seating=no contradicts the website FAQ, which clearly states 'Yes, we do! Our patio is open seasonally' — OSM tag appears incorrect.
OSM name is 'Luppolo Brewing Company' but the website consistently uses 'Luppolo Brewing Co.' — minor branding discrepancy, OSM value retained per rules.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active brewery and tasting room with confirmed bike racks, on-site washrooms, full food menu with vegan/GF options, and takeout beer sales — a strong fit for touring cyclists seeking a rest and resupply stop in Vancouver's East Side.
